list.title: Published snapshots
list.description: Attachments are files loaded with a model run, such as tools, SDKs or setup scripts. Each publish produces a snapshot with fixed content; identical content is the same snapshot. You can publish again based on any snapshot to branch in several directions. At run time, each trial copies the attachments into/opt/maestro/attachments/in its own container and runs their bootstrap.sh before the Agent starts; setup may use the network, while the Agent and verification still follow the platform's network limits.

publish.title: Publish a snapshot
publish.description: Choose the attachment's folder, with manifest.json at its root; an optional bootstrap.sh runs with bash, in the attachment directory, with the environment variable MAESTRO_ATTACHMENT_DIR pointing to it. Only files the server lacks are uploaded; publishing checks but does not run anything. File names may use only letters, digits and ._+@-; the .git directory is not uploaded. The label is optional, unique among attachments of the same name, and cannot be changed after publishing.
publish.basedOn: Will publish based on {{name}} {{snapshot}}; choose the edited folder.
publish.label: Label (optional)
publish.modeHint: Browsers cannot read file permissions: check the files that must be executable (by default kept from the parent snapshot, otherwise guessed from a leading #!).
publish.exampleNote: effects currently supports model_call, agent_tools and task_environment; attachments that change verification or scoring are not supported yet. compatible_harnesses lists Harness adapter names, or ["*"] for any. provides is used to detect conflicts between two attachments. Snapshots have no version number; tell them apart by the label given at publishing.
